name: multiplai-dev
description: Developer skill pack: spec-driven builds, executable plan authoring, refactoring, walkthroughs, e2e tests, cloud ops, skill authoring.

standards_files.title: buildme: standards files
standards_files.description: Coding-standards docs buildme's code reviewer reads on every block, separated by ':'. A relative path is looked up in the project, then each reference directory, then $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. specs/config.yaml's standards_files and the BUILDME_STANDARDS_FILES environment variable both replace this.

reference_dirs.title: buildme: reference directories
reference_dirs.description: Directories buildme looks up reference and standards doc names in, in order, separated by ':'. Replaces $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/reference/dev/. specs/config.yaml's reference_dirs and the BUILDME_REFERENCE_DIRS environment variable both replace this.
